run_memory_explorer: run the MemoryExplorer test case to set up an agent with two cubes for interactive memory exploration
add_two_cubes: add two cube objects at specified origins with name and shape relations to a test case
explore_agent_memory: explore the agent memory object after running the MemoryExplorer setUp to inspect memory contents
use_memory_filters: use the memory_filters module interactively to filter and query agent memory after running the main block
set_looking_at: set the agent's gaze direction to a specific block using the set_looking_at method
